extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, journalists and general readers seeking country factbook-style reference data
extracted.subtask_description: A standardized country/profile (factbook-style) entry giving geographic, demographic, governmental, economic, communications, transportation, military, and transnational data for a single country or territory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography (location and physical characteristics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geography — Location; Geographic coordinates; Map references; Area; Area - comparative; Land boundaries; Coastline; Maritime claims; Climate; Terrain; Elevation extremes; Natural resources; Land use; Irrigated land; Natural hazards; Environment - current issues; Environment - international agreements; Geography - note.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include precise location and coordinates, comparative area, land/water breakdown, coastline and maritime claims, climate and terrain descriptions, lowest and highest elevation points, list of natural resources, land use percentages (arable, permanent crops, other), irrigated land where available, natural hazards (e.g., hurricanes, permafrost, volcanoes), current environmental issues and relevant international environmental agreements, and any noteworthy geographic notes (e.g., ice cap, administrative peculiarities).

rubrics_metrics.name: People / Demographics
rubrics_metrics.description: People — Population; Age structure; Median age; Population growth rate; Birth rate; Death rate; Net migration rate; Sex ratio; Infant mortality rate; Life expectancy at birth; Total fertility rate; HIV/AIDS statistics; Nationality; Ethnic groups; Religions; Languages; Literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide population estimate (with date), detailed age-structure breakdowns (0-14, 15-64, 65+ with male/female counts where available), median age (total/male/female), growth, birth/death and migration rates, sex ratios by cohort and total, infant mortality by sex, life expectancy by sex and total, total fertility rate, HIV/AIDS prevalence/people/deaths if known, nationality (noun/adjective), ethnic composition percentages, religious composition, languages (official and common), and literacy statistics with definitions and notes where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government and Political Structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Government — Country name; Dependency status; Government type; Capital; Administrative divisions; Independence; National holiday; Constitution; Legal system; Suffrage; Executive branch; Legislative branch; Judicial branch; Political parties and leaders; Political pressure groups and leaders; International organization participation; Diplomatic representation in the US/from the US; Flag description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State conventional and local names, dependency/sovereignty status, precise government form, capital, administrative divisions, date/notes on independence, national holiday, constitution date, legal system basis, voting/suffrage rules, details on head(s) of state and government and recent election/electoral notes, structure and composition of legislature and judiciary, listing of major parties/leaders and any pressure groups, participation in international organizations, diplomatic representation details (ambassadors, consulates), and a concise flag description. Include election dates/results and notes where present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy (overview and key indicators)
rubrics_metrics.description: Economy — Economy overview; GDP (PPP); GDP - real growth rate; GDP - per capita; GDP - composition by sector; Population below poverty line; Household income/consumption share; Inflation rate; Labor force; Unemployment rate; Budget (revenues/expenditures); Agriculture products; Industries; Industrial production growth rate; Electricity production/consumption/exports/imports; Oil production/consumption/exports/imports; Exports and commodities; Export/import partners; Imports and commodities; Debt - external; Economic aid; Currency and code; Exchange rates; Fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a narrative overview of economic dependencies and prospects, and numerical indicators with dates: GDP (PPP) and growth rate, GDP per capita, sectoral composition (agriculture/industry/services), poverty rates, income distribution if available, inflation, labor force size and occupation shares, unemployment, government budget figures, main agricultural products and industries, energy statistics (electricity, oil), trade statistics (values, commodities, major partners), external debt, any economic aid/subsidies received, currency and ISO code, recent exchange rates, and fiscal year. Note years for each stat and include salient qualitative context (e.g., reliance on subsidies, tourism seasonality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and Media
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications — Telephones (main lines in use, mobile cellular); Telephone system (assessment, domestic, international); Radio and television broadcast stations; Radios and televisions counts; Internet country code; Internet hosts; Internet Service Providers (ISPs); Internet users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report fixed-line and mobile subscription counts with years, qualitative assessment of telephone system and transmission media (satellite, microwave, cables), counts of radio/TV broadcast stations and device ownership estimates, country internet ccTLD, number of internet hosts, ISPs, and estimated internet users. Include international connectivity details (satellite earth stations, international links) when present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation and Infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Transportation — Highways (total/paved/unpaved where applicable); Ports and harbors; Merchant marine; Airports (total and breakdown by runway type/paved vs unpaved).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List total highway length and pavement breakdown if available, principal ports and harbors, merchant marine size and composition, number of airports and categorization by runway surface and lengths (over/under given thresholds). Note special conditions (e.g., no roads between towns) and years for statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military and Defense
rubrics_metrics.description: Military — Military branches or note (e.g., defense responsibility of another state); Military expenditures where given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate presence/absence of regular military forces, note if defense is the responsibility of another country, list any named branches, and provide military expenditures (dollar figure and percent of GDP) if included. Include qualitative notes on bases or strategic importance when present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues / International Disputes
rubrics_metrics.description: Transnational Issues — Disputes - international; Illicit drugs; other transnational concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe ongoing international disputes (including brief location/context), note significant transnational crime or illicit drug transit/production issues, and any other cross-border concerns highlighted. Use concise factual statements (e.g., uncontested dispute over Hans Island).

rubrics_metrics.name: Metadata and update information
rubrics_metrics.description: Page metadata — 'This page was last updated on [date]'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clearly-stated last-updated date for the country entry; this is required metadata to indicate currency of the statistics and narrative. Also preserve source/attribution where given.
